claims.text: The source defines SDEdit: noise a guide image to time t0 then reverse a VE/VP SDE with a pretrained score model; t0 in [0.3,0.6] trades guide faithfulness vs realism; masked channel keeps unedited pixels identical (preservation target: guide structure/background identity).

Reported numbers: LSUN-bedroom human strokes L2 32.55 vs 53.76-101.18 baselines, realism preference 80.34-98.09%, satisfaction 75.43-91.72%; simulated strokes KID 0.0030 vs 0.0464-0.2070; compositing satisfaction +83.73%.
